CMOS hysteretic Schmitt trigger
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VIN vin 0 PWL(0 0 100n 0 1100n 3.3 1200n 3.3 2200n 0 2300n 0)
XDUT vdd 0 vin out astra_034_cmos_hysteretic_schmitt_trigger
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec upper range 1.8 2.4 unit=V
* @spec lower range 0.9 1.4 unit=V
* @spec initial range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec top range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec final range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec up_middle range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec down_middle range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 200p 2300n
meas tran upper FIND v(vin) WHEN v(out)=1.65 FALL=1
meas tran lower FIND v(vin) WHEN v(out)=1.65 RISE=1
meas tran initial FIND v(out) AT=50n
meas tran top FIND v(out) AT=1150n
meas tran final FIND v(out) AT=2250n
meas tran up_middle FIND v(out) AT=600n
meas tran down_middle FIND v(out) AT=1700n
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
